_notes: Tuteo, neutral Spanish as on the site. 'Músculos trabajados', 'técnica', 'series y repeticiones', 'ejercicios de pecho' follow HSN, Myprotein ES and Vitónica-style usage. 'Trabaja cuádriceps y glúteos' needs no article, so any muscle list fits; Nivel/Tipo are labels because 'ejercicio aislamiento' is wrong. GENERATOR NOTE: Spanish 'y' becomes 'e' before i-/hi- ('glúteos e isquiotibiales') and 'o' becomes 'u' before o-/ho-; the and/or join should handle that. Assumes lower-cased {level}/{mechanic}/{primary}/{muscle}.
